faqs.question: Is it breastfeeding safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, our post-pregnancy gummies have 30mcg biotin which makes it completely safe to consume for breastfeeding mothers.

faqs.question: Can this be used for sensitive scalp?
faqs.answer: We recommend doing a patch test before using the product.

faqs.question: Do the products in this kit have any side effects?
faqs.answer: While these multivitamin hair supplement gummies and hair growth serum have no recorded side effects, it is recommended not to exceed the recommended dosage.

faqs.question: Is it safe for pregnant women to take these as postpartum hair loss vitamins?
faqs.answer: If you are pregnant or nursing, consult a healthcare professional before taking not just this biotin supplement, but any supplement.

faqs.question: Can a person with diabetes use it?
faqs.answer: Our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free. It is absolutely safe for people with diabetes to consume. However, it is advisable to speak to an expert first.

faqs.question: Is it really sugar-free?
faqs.answer: Yes, our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free.

faqs.question: Do I need to wash off my hair after applying?
faqs.answer: No, our serum is water-based and it does not make your hair oily. It does not need to be washed off, in fact, we recommend leaving it on for long hours for best results.

faqs.question: Will this hair serum for women make my scalp oily?
faqs.answer: Our Hair Growth Serum is an aqua-based solution and it does not contain any kind of oils. It nourishes the scalp hence, you would not feel any dryness either.

faqs.question: Should this hair growth serum be applied on the scalp or hair?
faqs.answer: This concentrate should only be applied on the scalp. We recommend using our Hair Strengthening Serum on hair strands.

faqs.question: Can people below 18 use it?
faqs.answer: This product is recommended only for women above 18 years of age.
